backgrounds.name: Background Style
backgrounds.prompt: Create a soft pastel paper-craft diorama scene made from layered cut-paper shapes, with simple rounded forms, subtle drop-shadow depth, and a gentle, child-friendly pastel color palette. The scene should fill a full 16:9 frame and extend completely to the edges. Do not show people.

character.name: Character Style
character.prompt: A black-and-white cartoon line art illustration. Bold, uniform black outlines with clean, high-contrast shapes. Kid-friendly, humorous proportions with big expressive eyes, rounded features, and simplified anatomy. Playful coloring-book aesthetic with minimal background detail. Thick outlines, clear silhouettes, and a modern doodle/comic-strip vibe. No background images, just the character. Use a 16:9 portrait perspective.

scene.name: SceneStyle
scene.prompt: A black-and-white cartoon line art illustration. Bold, uniform black outlines with clean, high-contrast shapes. Kid-friendly, humorous proportions with big expressive eyes, rounded features, and simplified anatomy. Playful coloring-book aesthetic with minimal background detail. Thick outlines, clear silhouettes, and a modern doodle/comic-strip vibe. Use a 16:9 landscape perspective. Make sure it is a LANDSCAPE orientation.

clue.name: ClueStyle
clue.prompt: A black-and-white cartoon line art illustration. Bold, uniform black outlines with clean, high-contrast shapes. Kid-friendly, humorous proportions with big expressive eyes, rounded features, and simplified anatomy. Playful coloring-book aesthetic with minimal background detail. Thick outlines, clear silhouettes, and a modern doodle/comic-strip vibe. Use a 16:9 landscape perspective. Make sure it is a LANDSCAPE orientation. No characters should be visible. Be sure to confirm NO characters are in the scene.

map.name: Map Style
map.prompt: An isometric map view created as a soft pastel paper-craft diorama. The landscape is formed from stacked, layered cut-paper shapes with simple rounded edges and matte texture. 3D buildings rise vertically from the map like distinct paper pop-up models, specifically for the buildings referenced in the added images. The scene features subtle drop-shadows to create physical depth between the layers. The color palette is gentle and child-friendly, utilizing soft mints, pale blues, cream, and blush pinks. Full 16:9 frame, extending to edges, no people, soft studio lighting.
